What items are incredibly aggravating to resell on Craigslist or Ebay?

Car parts.

Let's say you have a Chevy. You have a copy of Haynes for that car, and you can do your own repairs, so when you have the chance, you get some spare parts. You acquire an O2 sensor, gas filter, etc.

Then you decide to sell that car. You look up all the Buicks, Saturns, etc. that your parts can be used in (for SEO) and you'll even throw in the Haynes manual for free if they've got a similar model of car. You price the parts at 20% of retail.

And you wait. You renew the listing. Finally, you get a nibble. "I'll pay you half of that", they say. You could say "Nah, I'll wait", but they probably know your listing has been around awhile and this is the only offer you'll get, so you'll probably cave after a brief and futile attempt to stand firm. So you pack up your parts and hope you can convince them to come all the way to you, or at least meet you at a mall within 20 miles. And if all goes well, you made just enough to keep you from just throwing out the parts next time. Or not.

Everything.

Ebay - every time there's some idiot who asks 20 questions, one at a time, wants additional pictures, and then doesn't buy the lousy $15 item.

Craigslist - always some prick emailing you "why is it so expensive?" every other day trying to beat you up on price, and at least half the people who say they're coming by, don't.

Now I just throw stuff away.

A sailboat. I've been trying for 3 years to offload a perfectly good Catalina 22. I get calls, drive out to the marina spend 45 mins with someone and never hear from them again. And it's not the price either, I'd pretty much give it away if someone would take it. I just want to offload the goddamn monthly slip fee.
